{{Top|leg|title=''Yulari''-class cruiser}}
The '''''Yulari''-class cruiser''' was a type of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] designed by the [[Faruun]] and used by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during their invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
These vessels backed up the majority of the Nagai fleet, consisting mostly of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].
